data.title: Payslip August 2026 – Muster Tech GmbH
data.explanation: This is your salary statement (Verdienstabrechnung) from your employer Muster Tech GmbH for August 2026. It shows your gross pay, the tax and social security deductions, and the net amount transferred to your bank account. As a working student (Werkstudent) you are exempt from health, long-term care and unemployment insurance contributions, so only income tax and pension insurance were deducted. No action is needed from you — just keep this document safely, as it can serve as proof of income (e.g. for tax returns, visa or landlord requests). If you spot an error in the hours, rate or deductions, contact your employer's HR/payroll department.
